paragraphs: A company that runs data centres says Ireland is a difficult place to invest now. Data centres are big buildings full of computers. They store information for the internet.
The company is called Stellanor. It is based in the UK. It has 11 data centres there. It has about 1.2 billion euro to spend on new projects.
This week Stellanor got a new boss, Gary Watson. He worked in Ireland for 27 years. He says the company will not build in Ireland for now.
He says there are many problems. It takes a long time to connect to the electricity network. The rules are not clear. Many people also say bad things about data centres.
The Government will spend 3.6 billion euro on the power network. But Mr Watson says this will take years. He thinks the UK is easier for now.
sentZh: 一家經營資料中心的公司表示，愛爾蘭現在是很難投資的地方。
資料中心是裝滿電腦的大型建築。
它們為網路儲存資訊。
這家公司叫做 Stellanor。
它的總部在英國。
它在英國有 11 座資料中心。
它有大約 12 億歐元可用於新計畫。
本週 Stellanor 有了新老闆 Gary Watson。
他在愛爾蘭工作了 27 年。
他說公司目前不會在愛爾蘭興建。
他說問題很多。
連接電網需要很長時間。
規定不清楚。
很多人也說資料中心的壞話。
政府將花 36 億歐元在電網上。
但 Watson 先生說這需要好幾年。
他認為目前英國比較容易。

paragraphs: A new business leader says Ireland has become a hard place for companies that want to build data centres. Data centres are large buildings where computers store and process information for the internet, governments and banks.

Stellanor Data Centres Group is a UK company supported by Deutsche Asset Management. It runs 11 data centres in Britain and has about 1.2 billion euro to grow in the UK, the Nordic countries and Ireland. This week it named Gary Watson, a well-known figure in Irish technology, as its chief executive.

Mr Watson says the company is waiting before it makes any plans in Ireland. He believes the country has stopped moving forward. He lists several problems: the electricity network is too busy, new grid connections are slow, Government policy is unclear and the industry has a negative image.

The Government promised 3.6 billion euro for the electricity grid in its latest budget. However, Mr Watson says the work will take years. He admits the industry has not explained its value well, even though ordinary people use data centres every day.
He also says new centres must use more renewable energy. Stellanor has about 600 customers, including governments, banks and emergency services.
sentZh: 一位新上任的企業領袖表示，愛爾蘭已成為想興建資料中心的公司難以發展的地方。
資料中心是大型建築，電腦在其中為網路、政府和銀行儲存並處理資訊。
Stellanor 資料中心集團是一家由德意志資產管理支持的英國公司。
它在英國經營 11 座資料中心，並有約 12 億歐元可用於在英國、北歐國家及愛爾蘭擴張。
本週它任命愛爾蘭科技界知名人物 Gary Watson 為執行長。
Watson 先生說，公司在愛爾蘭做任何計畫之前會先觀望。
他認為這個國家已經停滯不前。
他列出幾個問題：電網太過繁忙、新的電網連接緩慢、政府政策不明確，以及產業形象負面。
政府在最新預算中承諾撥出 36 億歐元用於電網。
然而，Watson 先生說這項工作需要好幾年。
他承認產業沒有好好說明自身價值，儘管一般人每天都在使用資料中心。
他也說新的資料中心必須使用更多再生能源。
Stellanor 約有 600 位客戶，包括政府、銀行和緊急服務單位。

paragraphs: The new head of a data centre group has warned that uncertainty over Government policy is driving high-tech investment away from Ireland. Gary Watson claims the country is currently "not investable" for his company.

Mr Watson was appointed chief executive of Stellanor Data Centres Group this week. The UK-based firm, backed by Deutsche Asset Management, operates 11 data centres in Britain and has around 1.2 billion euro available for expansion across the UK, the Nordic region and the Republic. Despite this, it has put its Irish plans on hold.

According to Mr Watson, who spent 27 years working in the Irish sector, the main obstacles are bottlenecks on the electricity network, long delays in securing grid connections, unclear policy and a negative public narrative about the industry. He warned that some professionals are even questioning whether Ireland is the right place for their careers.

Although the Government committed 3.6 billion euro to grid investment in Budget 2027, he said the upgrade would take years to deliver. He contrasted this with the UK, where he described ministers as highly engaged and new connection rules require developers to pay substantial deposits.

Mr Watson accepted that the industry has failed to communicate its benefits, noting that hospitals, banks and emergency services depend on data centres. He added that growth must be sustainable and supported by renewable power and battery storage.
sentZh: 一家資料中心集團的新負責人警告，政府政策的不確定性正把高科技投資趕離愛爾蘭。
Gary Watson 聲稱，對他的公司而言，這個國家目前「不值得投資」。
Watson 先生本週獲任命為 Stellanor 資料中心集團執行長。
這家總部設在英國、由德意志資產管理支持的公司在英國經營 11 座資料中心，並有約 12 億歐元可用於在英國、北歐地區及愛爾蘭擴張。
儘管如此，它已暫緩在愛爾蘭的計畫。
曾在愛爾蘭業界工作 27 年的 Watson 先生表示，主要障礙是電網瓶頸、取得電網連接的長期延誤、政策不明確，以及大眾對該產業的負面論述。
他警告，一些專業人士甚至開始懷疑愛爾蘭是否適合發展自己的職涯。
雖然政府在 2027 年預算中承諾投入 36 億歐元於電網，但他說升級工程需要數年才能完成。
他拿英國作對比，形容英國的部長們非常投入，而新的併網規定要求開發商支付高額保證金。
Watson 先生承認產業未能傳達自身的好處，並指出醫院、銀行與緊急服務都依賴資料中心。
他補充說，成長必須是可持續的，並以再生電力和電池儲能作為支撐。

paragraphs: The newly installed chief of a data centre operator has delivered a blunt verdict on Ireland, arguing that policy confusion has left the country "not investable" and is deterring high-tech capital. Gary Watson contends that Ireland has, in effect, stalled.

Mr Watson took the helm at Stellanor Data Centres Group this week. The British firm, bankrolled by Deutsche Asset Management, runs 11 facilities in the UK and has a war chest of roughly 1.2 billion euro earmarked for expansion in Britain, the Nordics and the Republic. Nonetheless, it is holding back on any Irish venture for the time being.

A veteran of the domestic sector, Mr Watson pinpointed several impediments: congestion on the electricity network, protracted waits for grid connections, ambiguous policy and a hostile narrative surrounding the industry. Such is the malaise, he suggested, that seasoned professionals are reconsidering whether their futures lie here.

While acknowledging the Government's pledge of 3.6 billion euro for the grid in Budget 2027, he cautioned that the benefits would materialise only over many years. By contrast, he portrayed British ministers as markedly engaged, with fresh connection rules obliging developers to lodge hefty deposits.

Mr Watson conceded that the sector has been inept at articulating its value, given that hospitals, lenders and emergency services rely on it daily. Expansion, he insisted, must nonetheless be sustainable and underpinned by renewables and battery storage.
sentZh: 一家資料中心營運商新上任的負責人對愛爾蘭作出直白的評斷，認為政策混亂已使這個國家「不值得投資」，並正在嚇阻高科技資本。
Gary Watson 主張，愛爾蘭實際上已經停滯。
Watson 先生本週接掌 Stellanor 資料中心集團。
這家由德意志資產管理出資的英國公司在英國經營 11 座設施，並備有約 12 億歐元的資金，指定用於在英國、北歐及愛爾蘭擴張。
儘管如此，它目前暫緩任何愛爾蘭的投資案。
身為國內業界的老將，Watson 先生指出幾項障礙：電網壅塞、等待併網曠日廢時、政策含糊，以及圍繞該產業的敵意論述。
他暗示，這股低迷氣氛嚴重到連資深專業人士都在重新考慮自己的未來是否在這裡。
他雖承認政府在 2027 年預算中承諾為電網投入 36 億歐元，但提醒其效益要多年後才會顯現。
相較之下，他形容英國部長們明顯積極投入，新的併網規定要求開發商繳交高額保證金。
Watson 先生承認該產業拙於闡述自身價值，畢竟醫院、放款機構與緊急服務每天都依賴它。
他堅稱，儘管如此，擴張仍必須是可持續的，並以再生能源和電池儲能為基礎。

paragraphs: The incoming chief executive of a data centre group has asserted that regulatory uncertainty is substantially undermining Ireland's appeal to high-technology investors. Gary Watson maintains that, under present conditions, the country is "not investable" for his organisation.

Mr Watson was appointed to lead Stellanor Data Centres Group this week. The UK-based enterprise, financed by Deutsche Asset Management, operates 11 facilities in Britain and has approximately 1.2 billion euro allocated for expansion across the UK, the Nordic region and the Republic. Nevertheless, its Irish strategy has been deferred indefinitely.

Drawing on 27 years of experience in the Irish sector, Mr Watson identified a series of constraints: insufficient capacity on the electricity network, prolonged delays in obtaining grid connections, inconsistent policy and an adverse public perception of the industry. Consequently, he argued, even experienced professionals are questioning the viability of their careers in Ireland.

Although the Government allocated 3.6 billion euro to grid infrastructure in Budget 2027, he emphasised that the resulting improvements are contingent upon a lengthy implementation period. In contrast, he characterised the British administration as proactive, citing new connection regulations that compel developers to provide substantial financial deposits.

Mr Watson acknowledged that the industry has inadequately communicated its significance, despite the fact that essential services depend on it. He stressed, however, that future development must remain environmentally sustainable, supported by renewable generation and battery storage.
sentZh: 一家資料中心集團即將上任的執行長斷言，監管的不確定性正大幅削弱愛爾蘭對高科技投資者的吸引力。
Gary Watson 堅稱，在目前的條件下，這個國家對他的機構而言「不值得投資」。
Watson 先生本週獲任命領導 Stellanor 資料中心集團。
這家由德意志資產管理出資、總部設在英國的企業在英國經營 11 座設施，並撥出約 12 億歐元用於在英國、北歐地區及愛爾蘭擴張。
然而，其愛爾蘭策略已被無限期延後。
憑藉在愛爾蘭業界 27 年的經驗，Watson 先生指出一系列限制：電網容量不足、取得併網的長期延誤、政策前後不一，以及大眾對該產業的負面觀感。
他認為，因此連經驗豐富的專業人士都在質疑自己在愛爾蘭職涯的可行性。
雖然政府在 2027 年預算中撥出 36 億歐元用於電網基礎建設，他強調相關改善取決於漫長的實施期。
相較之下，他形容英國政府積極主動，並舉出要求開發商提供高額保證金的新併網法規為例。
Watson 先生承認，儘管必要服務依賴該產業，產業卻未能充分傳達自身的重要性。
不過他強調，未來的發展必須維持環境上的可持續性，並以再生能源發電和電池儲能為支撐。
